contractFindings.statement: Release-visible explicit Save composition now exists: Heart makeForSavingMessages, AnyHanlinHost.makeForSavingMessages, and UIKit AnyHanlinPresentation.presentForSavingMessages.
The existing DEBUG acceptance factories remain available under DEBUG and delegate to the new factories with the same arguments; no prior public/acceptance API was removed.

Heart's new factory creates the same PinkhaHanlinCreatePageContext and calls the unchanged private make(context:includeSaveMessage:) with true. The shared installation, original generic Heart bindings, preflight, consent, protected journal, native runner dispatch, cancellation and drain source are unchanged.

Any's new host factory invokes the unchanged private initializer. Its existing expected-account, presentation-owner, creator/authority, native access, protected account-owner, shared router and Save binding setup are unchanged.

The new UIKit presentation entry creates AnyHanlinSaveMessageServices from the supplied original AnyHTTPClient and existing PinkhaHanlinOriginalMarkdownSavePlanner, then uses the unchanged private mount/presentation helper. The UI owner, consent installation, final mounting checks, revocation and asynchronous close behavior are unchanged.

Ordinary Heart make still uses includeSaveMessage:false; ordinary Any convenience init still passes saveServices:nil; ordinary AnyHanlinPresentation.present still constructs that ordinary host. This commit does not activate those ordinary editor entries for Save.

documentationCaveats: Heart's factory is app-internal rather than a newly public cross-module API. The Any presentation factory remains inside canImport(UIKit).

The low-level Any host factory accepts explicit AnyHanlinSaveMessageServices, including its conversion closure. The UIKit presentation factory is the entry that specifically installs the original Markdown converter; do not conflate those API contracts.

The map's unchanged reason contains historical fe0/cc839 claims that no production factory installs Save. These describe preserved older candidates and must not be restated as the current release-visible API surface.

Source publication does not prove Release compilation, mounted consent behavior, native full-body persistence/readback, authority behavior, Stop/EOF/account drain, or ordinary App adoption. Those acceptance obligations remain pending.
This finite peer checks the four published changes and literal predecessor preservation; it is not a new whole-App/dependency/API census or a requalification of unchanged implementations.
suggestedDocumentation: At f0eab88b57da3ef9b3586dc9a40c853948060eb9, explicit Hanlin Save composition is available outside DEBUG for both engines. The factories reuse the existing native constructors and shared mounted authority, consent, journal and cancellation/drain paths; DEBUG acceptance factories delegate to the same entry points. Ordinary Heart make, Any host initialization and editor presentation remain Save-disabled. Source publication is not actual native body/authority or mounted UI acceptance, and ordinary application adoption remains separately gated.
